rag.title: Citenest — document chat (RAG)
rag.description: SaaS that answers questions about your documents with citations to the source page, streamed token by token. Hybrid search (vector + BM25 fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion), cross-encoder re-ranking, asynchronous ingestion on Celery workers and Stripe subscriptions. React frontend in six languages, 74 tests and CI.

glucowidget.title: GlucoWidget — desktop glucose monitor
glucowidget.description: Windows and Linux widget that shows FreeStyle Libre glucose readings in real time through a custom client for the unofficial LibreLinkUp API. Optional AI analysis with 9 providers (including local Ollama), credentials kept in the system keyring and 45 tests. CI tests, packages and publishes executables for both systems on every push.

weather.title: Weather AI Dashboard
weather.description: Full-stack app that shows real-time weather for multiple cities and generates AI-powered insights. Spring backend, React frontend and a multilingual interface.

portfolio.title: Stock portfolio simulator
portfolio.description: Create, manage and analyze investment portfolios in a simple way. Go backend and a React + Vite frontend.

currency.title: Multilingual currency converter
currency.description: Currency converter with a multilingual interface, built with React.

statusChecker.title: HTTP status checker
statusChecker.description: Takes a URL and returns the response status: green for codes below 400, red for 400 and above.

megaSena.title: Mega-Sena results checker
megaSena.description: Script that compares the drawn numbers against games stored in a .txt file and lists the lines with 4 or more hits.
